prompt: I want to create a simple NFT on Sui. It should have a name and a description, and anyone should be able to transfer it. Write the Move module for me.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Struct has key and store abilities (store needed for public transfer)
Struct has id: UID as first field
Uses Move 2024 edition syntax (module declaration with semicolon)
Includes a constructor function that takes &mut TxContext

prompt: How do I create a new fungible token on Sui? Write me a complete module with minting capability.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Uses One-Time Witness pattern (struct named after module in ALL CAPS with drop ability)
Calls coin::create_currency in the init function
Handles TreasuryCap and CoinMetadata correctly
Includes a mint function that uses the TreasuryCap

prompt: I'm building a name registry on Sui where users can claim names. I want to emit events when names are registered. Write the Move code.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Event struct has copy and drop abilities
Uses sui::event::emit to emit events
Registry is a shared object
Uses a collection type (Table, VecMap, etc.) for name storage

prompt: Write a Move module for an event ticket that can be used exactly once. After use, the ticket should be destroyed. The ticket should not be transferable by the holder.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Ticket struct has key but NOT store (non-transferable by holder)
Includes a function that destroys the ticket by unpacking and calling id.delete()
Uses Move 2024 edition syntax

prompt: Build me a shared counter on Sui with increment and read functions. Include unit tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
Counter is shared via transfer::share_object
Test module uses sui::test_scenario or #[test] functions
At least one test verifies incrementing works correctly

prompt: Write a Move module called 'token_registry' with: a Registry shared object (has key) with id: UID and count: u64, a Token object (has key, store) with id: UID, name: String, and serial: u64, a TokenMinted event (has copy, drop) with token_id: ID and serial: u64. Write an init function that creates and shares the Registry. Write a public function mint_token that takes &mut Registry, name: String, and TxContext, increments count, creates a Token, emits TokenMinted, and returns the Token. Include tests verifying minting increments count and emits the correct event.

Write a Move module called 'admin' demonstrating the capability pattern. Create an AdminCap (has key, store) with id: UID. Create a Config shared object (has key) with id: UID and fee_bps: u64. In init, share Config and transfer AdminCap to sender. Write a public function update_fee that requires &AdminCap, takes &mut Config and new_fee: u64. Include a test that calls init, then update_fee.

Write a Move module called 'payment' that demonstrates coin operations. Write a public function split_and_send that takes a &mut Coin<SUI>, amount: u64, recipient: address, and TxContext. It should split the specified amount from the coin using .split() method syntax and transfer the split coin to the recipient using transfer::public_transfer. Include a test.
